newsitem.title: USA: Eagle Financial completes MidConn merger.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Financial completes MidConn merger.

text.p: Eagle Financial Corp said Monday it completed its previously announced $49.1 million acquisition of MidConn Bank effective May 31.
Eagle Financial said the acquisition would increase the number of its branch offices to 30 and its assets to $1.9 billion.
Pursuant to the merger, each share of MidConn's common stock has been converted into 0.86 shares of Eagle Financial common stock.
MidConn of Kensington, Conn., has 10 offices in Hartford County and $363 million in assets.
Eagle Financial is the holding company of Eagle Bank.
